messages:
harper_mkt: Quick sync  we have an analyst mention lined up for tomorrow's blog + a short co-hosted webinar later next week. Need PR outreach plan, CEO quote, webinar registration link, and support standby. Embargo til blog goes live. :calendar:
zane_pr: Great  what's the embargo time and the one-line angle for the analyst outreach?
harper_mkt: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. Angle: 'Redwood Inference demonstrates production cost controls that materially change LLM unit economics.'
maya_eng: Uploaded the end-to-end graphs and methodology doc to /shared/comm/analyst-mention-2026. For webinar slides use `/tools/slide-export --deck=analyst-talk --format=pdf`.
zane_pr: Draft CEO quote: "This recognition validates our focus on predictable, efficient inference for production teams." @kevin_ceo please review.
kevin_ceo: Small tweak: change 'recognition' -> 'analyst recognition' and approve. Final: "This analyst recognition validates our focus on predictable, efficient inference for production teams." Approved.
leo_support: Support will standby for first 2 hours after publish and cover the webinar Q&A channel. I'll post canned replies once PR sends the Q&A doc.
harper_mkt: Web registration: https://redwood.zoom.us/w/123456789. Can we have social copy and a short FAQ for the webinar page?
zane_pr: I'll prepare the embargo note for press and the webinar promo copy. Also setting up analyst outreach emails to top-tier contacts at 4:30 PM PT.
maya_eng: Note for press methodology blurb: 'We measured end-to-end inference cost and tail latency across realistic request mixes; all tests run on production-like traffic traces.'
scheduler-bot: CMS publish job queued: job_id=analyst-blog-176999, scheduled_time=1769991600, embargo=true.
harper_mkt: Please do not respond to any press queries before 9:00 AM PT. Direct all requests to @zane_pr. I'll post a final 'ready' at 4:15 PM PT.
zane_pr: Sending embargo email at 4:30 PM PT and attaching Q&A + interview availability. I'll ping top contacts after sending. :email:
leo_support: Triage channel ready: #support-webinar-176999. Canned replies uploaded to the playbook: https://drive.redwood/support/playbooks/analyst-webinar-2026.pdf
kevin_ceo: Thanks team. Let's keep responses consistent and route technical questions to Maya. Good luck. :rocket:
